question: Should ClawHub offer a public Verified or vetted-community path for third-party plugins like Spectyra, and should that signal be publisher-scoped, package-scoped, or evidence-only for now?
rationale: The current code intentionally treats Official/Verified as staff-controlled policy, while the requested public trust signal would influence user install decisions for executable community plugins.

options.title: Settle vetted-community policy first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 as the canonical decision point, then implement request criteria, public wording, review authority, revocation, and docs before granting Spectyra any new public trust state.

options.title: Grant one-off Official review
options.body: Staff could manually verify this publisher/package under the current Official model, but that would not create a reusable community path and could blur endorsement semantics.

options.title: Document no public path
options.body: Maintainers could state that community packages should rely on source-linked, scan, readiness, and provenance signals until a vetted-community program exists.

recommendation.title: Settle vetted-community policy first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 as the canonical decision point, then implement request criteria, public wording, review authority, revocation, and docs before granting Spectyra any new public trust state.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Official/Verified policy and UI surfaces most directly route through this history.
